content: That is incorrect. To qualify for a C permit (settlement permit) in Switzerland, you generally need to have held a valid B permit for at least ten years, not five. Additionally, the ten years of residence (which includes the time on the B permit) must include the last five years of uninterrupted residence in Switzerland. So, the five-year L permit does not count toward the ten-year B permit requirement. Please verify with the cantonal migration authority for the most up-to-date and specific information.
